verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: There is no scientific evidence linking 5G technology to the spread of the coronavirus. International health organizations and experts confirm that viruses cannot travel on radio waves or mobile networks.
verdicts.reasoning_en: A wide range of credible sources, including the United Nations' International Telecommunication Union (ITU), the World Health Organization (WHO), multiple independent fact-checking organizations, and government bodies, have all stated there is no scientific basis for the claim. Experts confirm that it is physically impossible for viruses to be transmitted via radio waves or mobile networks. The claim is a widely debunked conspiracy theory.
